curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach carrying proof of financial responsibility, the minimum coverage amounts, who insures minors, licensed sellers, and what uninsured crashes cost.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for the thirty, sixty and fifteen thousand minimums.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the coverage minimums and the uninsured penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the leading crash causes, what to do at a crash scene, exchanging information and police reports, and hitting parked cars, property or animals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for crash causes and each scene duty; a contrast card for injury crashes versus property-only crashes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz built on a crash scene.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain when a DMV report is due, who files the SR one, and how reported crashes reach driver records.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the reporting trigger, the SR one and records; a contrast card for police reports versus DMV reports.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a crash and asks whether a DMV report is due.
